title: Making Strides in Symbolic Imitation Learning: Offline Demonstrations, Online Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13182v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) methods have been the dominant paradigm in continuous control tasks due to their efficacy in function approximation, while interpretable evolutionary methods have lagged largely behind for the opposite reason. In this work, we introduce Symbolic Imitation Learning, a framework for distilling an oracle policy through an offline dataset into a decision list with linear model motion primitives. We show that this, in conjunction, with online Augmented-Random Search (ARS) tuning of the constants and motion primitives approximates the performance of the oracle across 20 benchmark RL tasks and exceeds the oracle in 11 of those 20 tasks while simultaneously producing parsimonious, interpretable policies that domain experts can better understand.

translated_title: 在符号模仿学习中取得进展：离线演示与在线调优
translated_abstract: 深度强化学习（DRL）方法凭借其在函数逼近方面的有效性，一直是连续控制任务中的主导范式，而具有可解释性的进化方法则恰恰因为相反的原因而大幅落后。在这项工作中，我们提出了符号模仿学习，这是一个通过离线数据集将oracle策略蒸馏为具有线性模型运动基元的决策列表的框架。我们表明，该方法结合在线增广随机搜索（ARS）对常数和运动基元的调优，在20个基准强化学习任务中能够逼近oracle策略的性能，并在其中11个任务上超越了oracle策略，同时生成了领域专家更容易理解的简洁、可解释的策略。
tldr: 提出符号模仿学习框架，通过离线数据将oracle策略蒸馏为线性运动基元的决策列表，并结合在线ARS调优，在20个强化学习基准任务中逼近oracle性能且在11个任务中实现超越，同时生成简洁可解释的策略。
en_tdlr: Introduces Symbolic Imitation Learning, which distills an oracle policy into decision lists with linear motion primitives from offline data, and with online ARS tuning approximates—and often exceeds—oracle performance on 20 RL benchmarks while producing parsimonious, interpretable policies.
